events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` navigates with `<button onclick="window.location.href='charts.html'">` (and two more), so you can't open them in a new tab and they aren't announced as links. The theme toggle is an icon-only emoji, the search has only a placeholder, and the Filters/Columns toggles have no `aria-expanded`.

## What to do

1. Replace the three buttons with `<a class="btn" href=...>`.
2. Add `aria-label` to the search and theme controls.
3. Set `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` in `togglePanel` in `public/app.js`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `onclick=` in `index.html`
- [ ] Nav entries are links
- [ ] Search and theme controls named
- [ ] Panel toggles report `aria-expanded`

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-owasp-metadata/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-metadata
```
